description: common.py defines make_model() so every script connects to the local Ollama endpoint in one place, and show_trace() to print each message part in a run.

steps.description: Set PYDANTIC_AI_NO_BANNER to silence the startup banner and import OpenAIChatModel and OllamaProvider.
make_model() connects to the local Ollama server at http://localhost:11434/v1 (or BASE_URL) and defaults to qwen2.5:3b unless you set the MODEL environment variable.
show_trace() loops over every message and its parts, printing tool calls, tool returns, retry prompts, and text content so you can inspect the full exchange.

title: Shared model builder and trace printer in common.py
